newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spreads unwind Monday's gains.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads unwind Monday's gains.

text.p: Australian bond spreads more than reversed their unexpected gains on Monday when the local bond market fell through support levels as traders took profits.
With the U.S. closed on Monday and Treasuries holding fairly steady in Tokyo, spreads to the U.S. widened by the extent of the local market weakening.
However, an overnight short-end rally in Canadian bonds and across the board gains in New Zealand saw spreads to those markets widen more.

Traders said that after touching their lowest levels since February 1994 on Tuesday, the local selling and subsequent spread widening may lead to offshore selling asd investors take the opportunity to realise profits.
"Whether that creates some selling offshore now remains to be seen," one trader said of the day's weakness. "I think it might."
"Offshore fund managers who play that spread probably would look at these levels as a good take profit (opportunity)," he saidh
The long end weakened most on the day after leading the short end higher on Monday.
As a result, the move of the futures curve to under 100 points was shortlived, and it reversed all of Monday's flattening.
